caption: This drawing consists of three main technical views of a chair, rendered in fine black lines on a beige background. The upper left section shows a top-down (plan) view of the chair seat and stretchers, annotated with measurements including 15 inches for the width and 18 inches for the depth, as well as details of the seat weaving pattern. The lower left section presents a front view of the chair, displaying the turned legs, stretchers, and three curved horizontal back slats. The lower right section depicts a side view of the chair, highlighting the profile of the seat, the backrest slats, and the arrangement of the legs and stretchers, with measurements including a total height of 39 1/8 inches and a seat height of 16 3/8 inches. In the upper right corner, there is a boxed label containing the reference number "35.1039-5," the word "CHAIR," and "BROOKLYN MUSEUM." All dimensions and features are labeled in inches. Near the bottom right corner, the name "B. Hoist Grube" appears, likely indicating the drafter. The composition is arranged with ample space around each view, and the linework is precise and detailed.
title: Side Chair
